# Sora 5.3.0 (variable weight, latin)

Copy of `files/sora-latin-wght-normal.woff2` and `LICENSE` (SIL Open Font License 1.1, saved as `OFL.txt`) from the npm package [`@fontsource-variable/sora@5.3.0`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fontsource-variable/sora/v/5.3.0).
It is the text typeface of the monA Bank web (#185, ADR 0023): labels, fields, descriptions and notices, next to Tektur for headings and amounts. Sora has no published WebJar, so it is kept here instead of in `pom.xml`, like Tektur and Motion (ADR 0016).

The tarball was checked against the registry's `dist.integrity`:
`sha512-h8kHta4Z8SkfUGeI82TUy1n3rbrKpBRGwuk4t4qCwto5oEHxlbOFD2yGP+Df5fbmTXwKGn+o667vYp0E4K8Whw==`.

To upgrade: download the new tarball, check its integrity, replace both files and update this note and ADR 0023.
